what: Item B-1 relies on two cp reuse-copy failures, but the existing cp shim can fail only the first matching copy
scenario_or_breakage: With the current CP_STUB_FAIL_TARGET_CONTAINS plus counter logic, the proposed three-slot fixture can only produce PHASE2_RELAUNCH_COUNT=1, so the new assertion for 2 cannot be made true without extra unstated harness work
suggested_fix: Minimally extend the cp shim to support two explicit fail target substrings or a delimiter-separated target list, preserving the existing single-target behavior, then use that in the B-1 scenario
